NewsArticle.Title: Sgrios Summonings
NewsArticle.Content:
The god of destruction, Sgrios, grows hungry for more destruction.
Succubi may now only be summoned by a level 60+ worshipper, Gargoyles by a level 30+ worshipper. All other creatures are summoned as before.
View [religious screenshots](http://www.darkages.com/play/s_religion.html) and [all screenshots.](http://www.darkages.com/pics/index_feature.html)
